author: claude
description: HedgeMaze(n=9, seed=0, height=3, hedge, bloom, path, base) is a (3n+1)-square perfect maze generated by randomized Kruskal (maze_passages(n, seed) is exported for other grid mazes): 2-wide dirt paths between 1-thick persistent leaf hedges flecked with flowering azalea, lanterns on every third post, entrance mid-south, exit mid-north, and an open 3x3-cell central plaza with the GoldenCheese prize (5x4x5 cheese wedge, cake and reward chest) and a glowing sign. Paths carve clearance so they clear terrain. Different seeds give different mazes. build(n, seed) has ground_level 1.
name: hedge_maze
title: Seeded hedge maze with the Golden Cheese

signatures.HedgeMaze: HedgeMaze(n=9, seed=0, height=3, hedge='minecraft:oak_leaves', bloom='minecraft:flowering_azalea_leaves', path='minecraft:dirt_path', base='minecraft:grass_block')
